product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides low-power machine-learning chips and development software for teams building and deploying physical AI applications on edge devices.

pricing_page.notes: Edgematic publishes Free, Premium and Business plans; paid tiers direct users to contact the company.

named_customers.notes: The reviewed case study anonymizes its customer as an “Industrial Leader”; the industry page combines customer and partner stories without distinguishing two customer-only relationships.

employee_band.notes: Company size reported on its LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Includes technical posts on Modalix chip design and the LLiMa compiler framework, authored by hardware and software engineering leaders.

public_docs.notes: Public Developer Center with hardware/software documentation and multiple application and model-serving tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job board lists Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517), San Jose; standalone posting details were not visible.

model_provider.notes: The conversational AI page explicitly describes Gemma language reasoning running on-device on Modalix.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed quality and privacy policies name none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 28, 2026; $150 million is the round amount, not the $500 million cumulative funding total.

raised_18mo.notes: The $150 million Series C was announced September 28, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The reviewed open-position list contains no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Palette Neat v0.5.0 was announced October 7, 2026, adding on-device image-understanding and voice capabilities, including a new default text-to-speech engine.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The four-person management team was checked: its members joined before the window, and no in-window executive departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No CRM or sales/marketing system was named in the reviewed job listings or developer documentation; this does not establish what it uses internally.
